notes: The genitive absolute splits under rule 74: Ἰησοῦ takes the subject word Jesus, and γεννηθέντος keeps the supplied subordinator when, the auxiliary was, and its own verb born.

τῆς Ἰουδαίας leaves the article unrepresented under rule 21's determinerless clause, the case preposition of staying with the noun; the same phrase is read identically at MAT.2.5 and MAT.2.22 (rule 24).
t026 saying is added under rule 37 and answers to MAT.2.2 s001, which that verse leaves unrepresented; both sides carry the cross-reference.
